# Parley v0.1.49

One fix, found by the v0.1.48 acceptance pass: choosing **Vendor's automatic
reviewer** in a pane's permission review did not reach the pane.

## The review kept the choice to itself

A new host Claude pane reviewed as Flexible with the vendor's reviewer opened
with "accept edits on" rather than "auto mode on", and auto mode had to be
switched on by hand. The pane's recorded selection still said the person
answers. Pressing Start hands the model the profile id and approved roots and
the model resolves the profile again from the current store; since v0.1.44
that second resolve was made without the approvals choice, so the Claude
launch never received `--permission-mode auto` and a Codex launch never
received auto review from a single-pane review either. Team members were
not affected, because the team grant carries the choice on its own path.

The hand-off now carries the choice, and the parameter is required rather
than defaulted so the next field added to a selection cannot be dropped the
same way. The scenario for P2.9 now checks the pane's own status line on its
first frame.

## Compatibility

Nothing else changed. Agent protocol unchanged at 32. A pane already reviewed
with the reviewer choice has to be restarted through its review for the
choice to take effect.

Validated: 348 native checks, 53 Node tests, public scan, platform scan and
build. The fix is in the app layer the checks cannot reach; the evidence is
the recorded selection on the tester's pane before the fix and the P2.9 step
after it.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
